source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the terrible desire and the source's present flees without softening the suffering.
key_decisions.before: And in those days people will seek death and will not find it; they will long to die, but death will flee from them.
key_decisions.after: In those days people will seek death and will not find it. They will long to die, but death flees from them.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And in those days people will seek death and will not find it; they will long to die, but death will flee from them.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned text without adding four to the horns.

key_decisions.after: The sixth angel sounded his trumpet. I heard one voice from the horns of the golden altar before God,

key_decisions.rationale: Renders twice ten-thousand times ten-thousand exactly and retains heard rather than counted.
